description:
Jack Righteous helps AI creators turn scattered AI experiments into clearer creative direction, stronger training paths, useful creator assets, and owned-platform growth.

Affiliates can promote practical AI creator training, AI music resources, digital products, VIP Plus, and Complete Access from JackRighteous.com.

Featured Offers for Affiliates

VIP Plus — Broad member access for creators who want Jack Righteous training, updates, and creator guidance across AI music, writing, branding, and platform-building topics.

Complete Access — The strongest available Jack Righteous access option for creators who want the broader package, including paid tool downloads and member resources where currently included by the product page.

Standard Paid Creator Products — Individual paid training products, starter resources, and creator-focused digital products for people who want a focused entry point before upgrading to broader access.

Unique Selling Points

Creator-first training for people building with AI

Strong fit for AI music creators, Suno users, AI writers, and digital creators

Clear access offers affiliates can explain without complicated funnels

Free resources available as warm-up links before recommending paid offers

Higher commission available on VIP Plus and Complete Access initial paid orders

Program Terms

Default Commission: 10% on standard qualifying paid products

Special Commission: Up to 20% on VIP Plus and Complete Access initial paid orders

Commission Type: Percentage of sale

Recurring Subscription Commission: No

Subscription Note: If a customer chooses a subscription option, only the first paid subscription order is commissionable. Monthly subscription renewals are not commissionable at this time.

Lifetime Commission: No

Cookie Duration: 30 days

Payouts: Monthly via PayPal after manual review

Minimum Payout: $20 unless otherwise stated

Affiliate Approval: Manual review

Promotion and Support

Affiliate Tracking: Unique referral links and assigned coupon codes where available

Marketing Materials: Approved banners, product images, copy blocks, and promotional guidance where available

Affiliate Support: affiliates@jackrighteous.com

Customer Support: support@jackrighteous.com

Member Support: members@jackrighteous.com

Basic Compliance Guidelines

Affiliates must clearly disclose their affiliate relationship.

No spam, fake urgency, misleading claims, or income guarantees.

No claims that Jack Righteous products guarantee fame, sales, streams, subscribers, royalties, business success, or platform growth.

No legal, financial, or music-success guarantees.

No brand-term PPC bidding, Google Ads, paid search, or search-engine ads without written permission.

Do not copy, resell, repackage, or redistribute paid Jack Righteous materials.

Do not promote monthly subscription renewals as commissionable.

Short Affiliate Pitch

A lot of people are making things with AI, but they do not know what to build around it.

Jack Righteous helps creators move from scattered AI experiments into clearer creative direction, better structure, and more useful creator assets.

Affiliates can promote creator training, VIP Plus, Complete Access, and qualifying paid digital products while earning commission on approved referrals.

Jack Righteous Creator Access Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions


By applying to or participating in the Jack Righteous Creator Access Affiliate Program, you agree to these terms.


1. Program Focus


This affiliate program is currently focused on approved sales of Jack Righteous VIP Access and the Complete Bundle Kit.


Affiliates earn commission only on eligible approved referred sales. Other products, free resources, articles, downloads, services, or future offers are not automatically included unless Jack Righteous clearly adds them to the affiliate program.


2. Commission


The launch commission rate is 15% on approved eligible sales.


Commission is only earned when a referral is properly tracked through an approved affiliate link or assigned affiliate coupon, and the sale is approved by Jack Righteous.


Commission is not paid on refunded orders, cancelled orders, fraudulent orders, test orders, duplicate orders, self-referrals, or orders that violate these terms.


3. Approved Offers


The eligible launch offers are:


- VIP Access

- Complete Bundle Kit


The Complete Bundle Kit is the broader full-access package connected to Sound, Voice, Brand, Expansion Paths, and Premium Market Paths. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}


4. Affiliate Links and Coupons


Approved affiliates may receive a tracking link and, if assigned, an affiliate coupon code.


Affiliates are responsible for using the correct link and code. Jack Righteous is not responsible for missed commission if an affiliate uses the wrong link, posts an expired offer, or fails to follow program instructions.


5. Payouts


Payouts are reviewed manually.


The minimum payout threshold is $20 unless otherwise stated.


Approved commissions are normally paid monthly after review. Jack Righteous may delay or deny payout if an order is refunded, cancelled, disputed, suspected of fraud, or connected to improper promotional activity.


Affiliates are responsible for any taxes, reporting, or payment account requirements connected to their commission earnings.


6. Required Disclosure


Affiliates must clearly disclose their affiliate relationship when promoting Jack Righteous offers.


Required disclosure example:


“I may earn a commission if you purchase through my link or use my code.”


Affiliate disclosures must be clear, visible, and placed close to the recommendation or link. The FTC says affiliate marketers should disclose commission relationships clearly and conspicuously, and the Competition Bureau Canada says material connections such as commissions should be disclosed clearly. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}


7. Promotional Rules


Affiliates may promote Jack Righteous offers through websites, email, social media, video, communities, and direct recommendations, as long as the promotion is honest, clear, and compliant with these terms.


Affiliates may not:


- Make false or misleading claims

- Promise guaranteed income, fame, results, sales, subscribers, or success

- Say VIP Access includes paid tool downloads if that is not stated on the product page

- Say services, one-on-one work, legal advice, copyright protection, or custom consulting are included unless clearly stated by Jack Righteous

- Use spam, fake accounts, bots, misleading ads, or deceptive promotions

- Use Jack Righteous, Bee Righteous, The Righteous Beat, or confusingly similar names in domains, social handles, ads, or pages without written permission

- Run paid ads using Jack Righteous brand terms without written permission

- Promote outdated pricing, expired discounts, or unsupported claims

- Misrepresent the relationship between the affiliate and Jack Righteous


8. Brand Use


Affiliates may use approved links, descriptions, and promotional materials provided through the affiliate program.


All Jack Righteous, Bee Righteous, and related brand names, logos, graphics, product names, and training materials remain the property of their owner. Affiliates may not copy, resell, repackage, or redistribute paid training materials.


9. Approval and Removal


Jack Righteous may approve, reject, suspend, or remove any affiliate at any time.


Affiliate participation may be ended for inactivity, abuse, misleading promotion, brand misuse, non-disclosure, fraud concerns, or any behavior that creates buyer confusion or harms the brand.


10. Program Changes


Jack Righteous may update commission rates, eligible offers, payout rules, promotional rules, program access, or these terms at any time.


Continued participation in the affiliate program after updates means the affiliate accepts the updated terms.


11. No Employment Relationship


Affiliates are independent promoters. Participation in this program does not create an employment, partnership, agency, franchise, or joint venture relationship.


12. Contact


Questions about the affiliate program, tracking, payout, or approved promotional language should be sent through the official Jack Righteous support contact listed on JackRighteous.com.
